verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog docs say it automatically tracks lineage as data and AI assets are used and logs activity for auditing. Delta table history can be used to audit operations, which covers the 'who ran what' half at a high level. Column-level lineage is never stated: lineage is described only generically, and the Genie Code mention of 'tables, columns, and lineage' does not establish column-granular lineage. Missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage documentation, detail on audit log contents and delivery (user/action records, system tables or log export), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
